mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 235.0) increase discount rates and reduce liquidity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0 and CPIAUCSL > 235.0, or interaction Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP contraction (GDPC1 below 10-year quarterly average) indicates weakening economic fundamentals, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 < 10-year average, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 900 thousand units signal weak consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 900.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Declining non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) indicates weak labor market amid monetary easing, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
regime_hint: weak labor market with monetary easing
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or interaction Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates supply chain disruptions, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.
